$comment: AI assistant (feature 005): the feature's catalogue, deep-merged into the base catalogue by ui/src/i18n/index.ts; en, ru and uk stay in parity (tools/i18n-check.mjs). T008 laid the skeleton, T028 added the shared strings - the View menu entry and the three commands, the context-menu entry, the banner label and the operation phases, the failure texts per Failure.kind (data-model §4.5; `ai.failure.withMessage` embeds the service's own words), the 1200 reasons, the list-issue reasons, the end-state lines and the plural families for counts; the settings page (dialog.settings.ai.*), the popup, the panel and the notice are added by the stories. The service names, model names and example addresses below are the same in every language (ui/src/i18n/identical-allowlist.json).

toggle.description: Show or hide the AI assistant panel

ask.description: Change the selected text as you instruct the AI assistant

cancel.description: Stop the AI assistant's running request

script.$comment: Dialogs of a script run by the assistant inside a request (feature 005 FR-080, review C10; scripting/api-impl.ts `dialogCaption`).

popup.$comment: The "Ask AI..." popup of the Body view (FR-030, FR-034; ai/AskPopup.tsx): the selection size as selected, the service, the progress and the result forms.
popup.title: Ask AI
popup.placeholderSelection: What should the assistant do with the selected text?
popup.placeholder: Your instruction or question (the paragraph at the caret is offered as context)
popup.noSelection: no selection — the paragraph at the caret
popup.answered: The assistant answered; the book was not changed.
popup.undoHint: Later changes were made; use Edit > Undo.
popup.cutOff: The answer was cut off by the service and was not applied.
popup.nothingToChange: Nothing to change: the assistant returned the selection as it is.

banner.$comment: The run banner's label while an AI request holds the lock (FR-022): `<service name> · <model>`.
banner.label: {{service}} · {{model}}

phase.$comment: The current operation shown by the banner, the panel and the popup (FR-022; data-model §4.3).
phase.limitWait: waiting as the service asked: {{seconds}} s left

failure.$comment: One text per Failure.kind (data-model §4.5); `withMessage` wraps it with the service's own words when the failure carries them; `limitWait` names the wait that was not waited for.
failure.offline: The service could not be reached. Check the network connection and the address.
failure.timeout: The service did not answer within the time limit.
failure.tls: A secure connection to the service could not be established (certificate or TLS problem).
failure.auth: The service refused the request: the key is missing or invalid. Check the key in Settings > AI assistant.
failure.model: The service does not know the model. Check the model name in Settings > AI assistant.
failure.limit: The service's limit was reached and waiting any longer would take the request past 5 minutes.
failure.limitWait: The service asked for a wait of {{seconds}} s, which would take the request past the 5-minute total.
failure.oversize: The request is too large for the service even after shortening.
failure.paragraphTooLarge: A single paragraph of the selection is too large for the service.
failure.service: The service answered with an error.
failure.redirect: The address redirects to another one; enter the final address in Settings > AI assistant.
failure.format: The service's answer could not be understood (unexpected format).
failure.truncated: The service's answer was cut off before the end; it was not applied.
failure.contentFilter: The service declined the request because of its content rules.
failure.invalidAtEnd: The result would leave the book invalid; nothing was changed.
failure.validationUnavailable: The book cannot be validated right now (the schema is unavailable), so no change was applied.
failure.busy: A script is running; wait until it ends.
failure.noService: No AI service is available. Check Settings > AI assistant.
failure.internal: Something went wrong inside the editor; the book was left unchanged.

noService.disabled: The AI assistant is disabled in Settings.
noService.unknownService: The chosen service "{{id}}" is not in the service list.
noService.noModel: No model is set for the service.
noService.noAgreement: You have not agreed to send text to this service yet.

listIssue.$comment: The reasons of a service list issue (`ai.services().issues[].reason`, data-model §1.3).
listIssue.unreadable: The file could not be read.
listIssue.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
listIssue.notObject: Something else stands where an object was expected.
listIssue.missingField: The field "{{field}}" is missing or of the wrong type.
listIssue.badAddress: The address is not a valid http(s) URL.
listIssue.badId: The identifier is not valid (lower-case Latin letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-" only).
listIssue.duplicateId: The identifier is already used by an earlier entry; this entry is skipped.
listIssue.badField: The field "{{field}}" has a wrong type or value and was ignored.

end.$comment: The end states of a request (data-model §4.3; review C5).
end.committed: The changes were applied to the book.
end.answered: The assistant answered; the book was not changed.
end.askedBack: The assistant asked a question; the book was not changed.
end.rejected: The request was stopped: the same change was rejected three times. The book was not changed.

notice.$comment: The first-use notice shown before the first request to a hosted service (FR-021; ai/notice.tsx). The list names exactly what leaves the computer - nothing else is sent (review C14).
notice.title: Sending text to an AI service
notice.sentIntro: When you use this service, the editor sends it over the Internet:

sent.outline: the book's title and its chapter titles
sent.parts: the parts of the book the assistant reads for the task

notice.terms: Terms of use and privacy policy of the service
notice.unencrypted: The address is plain http: the text travels unencrypted.
notice.question: Do you agree to send this to the service?

ai.$comment: Settings > AI assistant (FR-001 to FR-009; dialogs/settings/AiPage.tsx). Service names, model names and addresses are data of the list file and are not translated.
ai.disabledNote: The assistant is removed from the menus, the toolbar and the shortcuts; nothing of it is loaded.
ai.limitsUnknown: Limits: not stated by the list file
ai.termsLink: Terms of use and privacy policy of the service
ai.toolsNote: answers only — cannot operate the editor
ai.replaced: Your list file replaces this entry of the bundled list.
ai.fallback: Your list file no longer has "{{id}}"; the first entry is selected instead.
ai.emptyList: No usable service: the list files contain no valid entry.
ai.listUnavailable: The service list is available only while the editor is connected to its core.
ai.coreTooOld: The core of this installation is older than the AI assistant needs (API revision 4): the assistant is not available.

custom.addressError: The service address must be an http or https URL with a host name (for example https://api.openai.com/v1).
custom.modelError: Name the model of your service (type it or pick one with Fetch models).

files.title: Service list files
files.userMissing: Your list: {{path}} (not created yet — Edit list creates it)
files.created: Your list file was created as a copy of the bundled list; edit it and press Reload list.
files.exists: Your list file already exists and was left unchanged.
files.createFailed: Your list file could not be created: {{reason}}

issues.title: Problems in the list files (the rest of the list is in use):

agreements.title: Services you agreed to send text to
agreements.none: None yet: the notice is shown before the first request to a hosted service.
